facts.statement: The type species of Qingxiusaurus is Q. youjiangensis, which was described by Mo et al. in 2008.
facts.quote: The type species, described by Mo et al. in 2008, is Q. youjiangensis.

facts.statement: Like other sauropods, Qingxiusaurus was a large quadrupedal herbivore.
facts.quote: Like other sauropods, Qingxiusaurus would have been a large quadrupedal herbivore.

facts.statement: Qingxiusaurus belongs to the parent group Saltasauridae.
Qingxiusaurus is classified in the family Saltasauridae.
Qingxiusaurus is a member of the class Saurischia.
Qingxiusaurus lived during the Cenomanian to Maastrichtian stages, between 100.5 and 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Cenomanian to Maastrichtian (100.5 to 66 million years ago)
